Declare the unit-of-record table of a pollination study

Source: R/data.R
pollin_data.Rd

Pairs a data frame with a role map naming which columns are responses, the pollination treatment, the units the treatment is applied within, and the optional grouping, denominator, exposure and adjustment columns. The roles are checked against the data when the object is built, and the structural checks of pollin_validate() are run and stored, so every later step works from one validated description of the table.

Usage

pollin_data(
  data,
  response,
  treatment,
  unit,
  groups = NULL,
  denominator = NULL,
  exposures = NULL,
  adjust = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame, one row per unit of record (for example one plant under one pollination treatment).

response

Character vector of response column names (for example pod number, seed weight). Each must be numeric.

treatment

Name of the pollination treatment column (for example caged versus open). It must have at least two distinct non-missing values.

unit

Character vector of the columns identifying the units the treatment is applied within, outer to inner (for example c("Site", "Plot")).

groups

Optional character vector of further grouping columns that are not part of the unit nesting (for example region, variety or year).

denominator

Optional name of a numeric column giving the number of trials each response is counted out of (seeds out of ovules, pods out of flowers). Values must be non-negative. With a denominator, every response is a count of successes out of that many trials and is fitted as binomial by pollin_fit(); each response must then be a whole number between 0 and the denominator, and the denominator positive, on the rows fitted. The arm means of pollin_effects() are then expected proportions (successes / trials), averaged over the rows with equal weight, whatever each row's number of trials.

exposures

Optional character vector of exposure columns (for example insect abundances).

adjust

Optional character vector of adjustment covariates (for example landscape or climate).

Value

An object of class pollin_data: a list holding data, the role map roles, the number of rows n, and the structural check table checks.

Details

pollin_data() records what the columns are. How the units are nested and which treatment levels form the arms of the experiment are declared in the design step that follows.

See also

pollin_validate() for the checks, with expected levels and internal-consistency identities.

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  pods = rpois(40, 30),
  trt = rep(c("Cage", "Open"), 20),
  Site = rep(letters[1:4], each = 10),
  bees = rpois(40, 5)
)
pd <- pollin_data(df, response = "pods", treatment = "trt", unit = "Site",
                  exposures = "bees")
pd
#> <pollin_data>
#>   rows        : 40 
#>   response    : pods 
#>   treatment   : trt ( Cage, Open )
#>   unit        : Site 
#>   exposures   : bees 
#>   checks      : 0 warnings; see `$checks`
